eyebrow: How a kitchen happens · Ashby & Rowe
headline: Twelve weeks from a tape measure to _the first dinner._
lede: Five stages, the same order every time. Each one ends with something you can hold, so you always know where the money and the weeks have gone.

steps.title: Measured survey
steps.summary: We measure every wall, pipe and socket, and talk through how you actually cook.
steps.give: Two hours at home, your wishlist and a few photos of kitchens you like

artifact.alt: A measured plan of the kitchen, 3420 by 2860 mm, with the window, door, units and gas point marked

steps.title: Design and a fixed quote
steps.summary: Two rounds of changes are included. The price we quote is the price you pay.
steps.give: One showroom visit to choose doors, worktop and handles
steps.get: A 3D plan and a fixed quote, held for 60 days

artifact.alt: Quotation Q-2611: six lines adding up to a fixed total of £17,500, stamped held for 60 days
artifact.title: Ward kitchen, fixed price

steps.title: Made in our workshop
steps.summary: Carcasses, doors and the oak worktop are cut and finished to your survey, not pulled from a catalogue.
steps.give: Nothing but patience, and the deposit
steps.get: A booked delivery date and a photo update every Friday

artifact.alt: The workshop's Friday log, one line a week from week 3 to week 8, ending with the delivery booked
artifact.title: Friday updates

entries.label: Wk 3
entries.text: Ash boards chosen and stacked to settle

entries.label: Wk 5
entries.text: Doors routed, first coat of paint

entries.label: Wk 6
entries.text: Worktop oiled, second coat on doors

entries.label: Wk 7
entries.text: Dry fit in the shop, photographed

entries.label: Wk 8
entries.text: Wrapped. Delivery booked Mon 9 March, 8 am

steps.title: Fitting
steps.who: Two fitters, the same faces every day
steps.summary: Old kitchen out, services moved, new kitchen in. Dust sheets down and swept every evening.
steps.give: A key, and three weeks without a kitchen
steps.get: A site log by text at 5 pm every working day

artifact.alt: The fitting log sent by text each evening, from the old kitchen coming out to the wall units going up
artifact.title: Brook Lane, fitting

entries.label: Day 41
entries.text: Old kitchen out. Water capped, skip gone.

entries.label: Day 42
entries.text: New sockets in, first-fix plumbing done.

steps.title: Handover
steps.summary: We walk every drawer and hinge with you, fix what you find, then hand over the paperwork.
steps.get: A signed snag list and a 10-year guarantee

artifact.alt: A ten-year guarantee certificate for the cabinets, numbered 2611, with the snag list closed
artifact.title: Ten-year guarantee
artifact.body: Cabinet carcasses, doors, hinges and runners at 14 Brook Lane, from handover on 24 March.
